title: 第五章  猎得野猪刮目相看第六章  售三两银箭术小成
slug: 武道长生从边关猎户开始黄袍加身
lines: 一支箭矢突然从某处激射而出，径直射入树上的野鸡体内。
野鸡来不及惨叫，便应声掉在了地上。
陆川面带喜色，将野鸡捡起，照例用草绳拴在腰间。
今日的打猎还算顺利，来到一重山不过小半天时间，便分别打到了一只兔子、一只野鸡。
按照这个情况，陆川预想今天的收获会比昨天更多。
陆川一路摸索搜寻猎物，不知不觉便来到了一重山与二重山的交接处，犹豫半晌，还是没有贸然进入。
他打算通过每日结算，让自身变得更加强大后，再进入二重山打猎。
就在陆川转身，准备继续在一重山搜寻猎物时，二重山方向突然传来嘈杂声：
“追！快追！别让它跑了！”
“这只野猪，可是难得的好猎物。”
声音由远及近，没等陆川反应，突然，一头大野猪从林子中钻了出来。
野猪！
陆川心头一热，下意识就要弯弓搭箭。
如果能拿下，少说得几两银钱。
但犹豫一息，陆川放下了手里的弓箭。
从目前的情况来看，这只大野猪明显是被其他猎人赶出来的。
就算自身出手将其射死，这野猪的所有权也不一定属于自己。
只是片刻，野猪跑出去数十米，而紧接着，林子里又钻出三个人。
陆川放眼看去，只见那三人均是一身劲装，胸前赫然绣有‘沧海武馆’四个大字。
是沧海武馆的弟子！
陆川眼神闪过惊诧。
但他并没有出手帮忙拦住这只野猪，反倒是主动退后一段距离，给三人让出了空间。
那三名沧海武馆弟子只是瞥了陆川一眼，随即喝道：
“动手！”
只见几人的奔跑速度骤然加速，手中弯弓搭箭，
一瞬间，数只箭矢飞出，直直朝着野猪袭去。
野猪似乎感知到了危险，身体猛地一闪，突然转变方向，一股脑钻进了茂密的林子，不见了踪影。
“哎呀！怎么就给他跑了！”
其中一名脸上长着黑痣的弟子，猛地将手里的长弓摔在地上。
其余两人亦是连连抱怨道：
“运气真差啊！”
“白白让这猎物跑了，心疼死我了！”
陆川见状，为了避免误会，也不好继续留在这里，正要转身离开，
“你这人，怎么不帮我们拦住它！”
content_en:
"Whoosh!"
An arrow suddenly shot out from somewhere and shot straight into the body of the pheasant on the tree.
The pheasant didn't have time to scream and fell to the ground.
With a happy face, Lu Chuan picked up the pheasant and tied it to his waist with a straw rope as usual.
Today's hunting went smoothly. It took only half a day after arriving at Yichuan Mountain to catch a rabbit and a pheasant respectively.
According to this situation, Lu Chuan expected that today's harvest would be more than yesterday.
Lu Chuan groped for prey all the way, and unknowingly came to the junction of the First Level Mountain and the Second Level Mountain. After hesitating for a long time, he still did not enter rashly.
He planned to make himself stronger through daily settlement before entering Erzhong Mountain for hunting.
Just when Lu Chuan turned around and prepared to continue searching for prey on the First Level Mountain, a noise suddenly came from the direction of the Second Level Mountain:
"Chase! Chase quickly! Don't let it run away!"
"This wild boar is a rare and good prey."
The sound came from far away, and before Lu Chuan could react, a big wild boar suddenly emerged from the forest.
Wild boar!
Lu Chuan's heart felt hot, and he subconsciously bent his bow and arrow.
If you can win it, you'll get a few taels of silver at least.
But after a moment of hesitation, Lu Chuan put down the bow and arrow in his hand.
Judging from the current situation, this large wild boar was obviously driven out by other hunters.
Even if you shoot it to death, the ownership of the wild boar does not necessarily belong to you.
In just a moment, the wild boar ran out for tens of meters, and then, three more people emerged from the forest.
Lu Chuan looked around and saw that the three people were all dressed in smart clothes, with the four characters "Canghai Martial Arts School" embroidered on their chests.
He is a disciple of Canghai Martial Arts School!
Lu Chuan's eyes flashed with surprise.
But he did not help stop the wild boar. Instead, he took the initiative to step back a distance to make room for the three of them.
The three Canghai Martial Arts School disciples just glanced at Lu Chuan and then shouted:
"Do it!"
I saw a few people running at a sudden speed, with bows and arrows in their hands.
"Whoosh! Whoosh! Whoosh!"
In an instant, several arrows flew out and struck straight at the wild boar.
The wild boar seemed to have sensed the danger. It jerked its body, suddenly changed its direction, and disappeared into the dense forest.
"Oh! Why did he run away!"
One of the disciples with a black mole on his face suddenly threw the long bow in his hand to the ground.
The other two people also complained repeatedly:
"What bad luck!"
"I let this prey escape in vain, I feel so sad!"
When Lu Chuan saw this, he was about to turn around and leave in order to avoid misunderstanding.
"Why don't you help us stop it!"
